title: Rebuilding baoopn.com in 2026
excerpt: How I rebuilt my portfolio and blog as a Go API and a SvelteKit app: the admin dashboard, a contact form that becomes email threads, cookieless analytics, and how it ships.

parts.title: Why I rebuilt it, and how it fits together
The admin dashboard: Clerk auth, the Markdown editor, and GitHub sync
From contact form to email thread
Shipping it: Docker, Coolify, and a deploy gate
Lessons learned and what I would change
